subject: POC trial planning: Acme Industries - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-industries.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme-industries.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: POC trial planning: Acme Industries - next steps

Hi Samantha and Tom,

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier — great to hear more about the search-and-summarization use case for your customer support workflows. Per our conversation, I wanted to capture the proposed POC scope and next steps so we can align on timelines and owners.

High-level POC goal:
- Validate that Redwood inference can meet your latency SLOs (<250ms median), reduce per-response cost by at least 30% vs current solution, and improve answer relevance on the top-10 support intents.

Proposed success criteria (initial):
- Latency: median end-to-end <250ms for 95% of queries in the test harness
- Cost: token-based cost reduction >=30% over the trial dataset at production-ish load
- Quality: 80%+ relevance on internal eval prompts (will share eval set)
- Integration: model returned structured metadata fields for downstream ingestion

Evaluation plan and milestones:
1) Kickoff & sandbox access (Week 0) — Apr 7: set up test keys, dataset access, data ingestion checks
2) Baseline run (Week 1) — run your current model + Redwood baseline on sample traffic
3) Optimization iteration (Weeks 2-3) — batching/quantization tweaks, kernel selection, caching
4) Final readout (Week 4) — latency/cost/quality results, recommended config + next steps

Owners:
- Redwood: Marissa (overall POC), Vivek (engineering liaison / infra setup), Rishi (quality & evaluation)
- Acme: Samantha (product owner), Tom (platform/eng lead)

Immediate next steps:
- I will send a POC plan doc with timelines and a checklist (see attachment).
- Can you confirm availability for a 60-minute kickoff on Apr 7 between 10:00–12:00 PT?
- Please share the sample dataset access method (S3 bucket or secure transfer) and any IP allowlist requirements.

Attachments: POC Plan v1.pdf (draft), data-access-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-industries.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme-industries.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial planning: Acme Industries - next steps

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and covers what we discussed. Quick clarifications:

- Success criteria: the product team would like to add a KPI around answer consistency for the top-5 intents (we can share an intent mapping sheet). Can Rishi help define the eval metric for that?
- Data: we can provide an S3 bucket with sample anonymized transcripts. I will loop in our security contact if there's an allowlist/egress requirement.
- Kickoff: Apr 7 at 10:30 PT works for Tom and me.

One ask: could you include a short section in the POC doc on what happens post-POC (options for Dedicated vs Private) so we can prep internal stakeholders?

Best,
Samantha
Product Manager, Search
Acme Industries
samantha.lee@acme-industries.com

Looping in a couple of quick clarifications and the acceptance checklist ahead of kickoff:

Acceptance checklist (final):
- Latency target: median <250ms (95th percentile under 400ms) — validated in test harness
- Cost target: >=30% reduction measured on token accounting for the baseline
- Quality: >=80% relevance on the top-10 intents; top-5 intent consistency score >=0.85 (we'll compute with the eval rubric)
- Integration: structured metadata fields present and schema validated by Acme (schema file in drive)

Meeting cadence:
- Kickoff: Apr 7, 10:30 PT (60m) — agenda: intro, infra checklist, data access, baseline plan
- Weekly check-ins: Mondays, 10:30 PT, 30m (Vivek will lead infra updates)
- Final readout: Apr 29, 11:00 PT (60m) — stakeholders: Marissa, Samantha, Tom, Rishi, Acme analytics lead

I'll send the eval rubric and a short script to compute the consistency metric before the kickoff. Also sending a calendar invite now (invite: POC Kickoff — Redwood x Acme).

--
